what: Three unnumbered, unlabelled diagrams with blank label lines printed under Q.6: (1) a stoma in surface view among epidermal cells (kidney-shaped guard cells round the pore), three label lines; (2) outline of a shoot with a shaded tip, two shaded bands at a node and two vertical strips lower down (location of apical, intercalary and lateral meristem, as Fig. 8.2), three label lines; (3) outline of a root tip with root hairs and a shaded tip, two label lines

Diagram a of Q.7: a sector of a root transverse section (epidermis with root hairs, a darker outer layer, broad cortex, endodermis ring, pericycle, alternating xylem and phloem patches, central cells), unlabelled, about seven label lines
Diagram b of Q.7: a group of loosely arranged rounded green cells full of chloroplasts with intercellular spaces (parenchyma containing chloroplasts), unlabelled, four label lines
Diagram c of Q.7: a stoma in surface view, dark green kidney-shaped guard cells round the pore, ringed by pink subsidiary cells and outer epidermal cells, unlabelled, about seven label lines

Diagram d of Q.7: a transverse section of a leaf (upper epidermis, palisade layer, a vascular bundle with bundle sheath, spongy mesophyll with air spaces, lower epidermis with a stoma), unlabelled, about eleven label lines
